purpose: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, creating ADRs and glossary docs along the way.
use_when: Grilling a plan or spec with interview questions before implementing
Sharpening a design approach through docs-grounded Q&A, producing ADRs
Aligning with the agent on requirements before code is written
do_not_use_when: Doing visual or UI design implementation (use frontend-design)
Writing code directly without an interview step
scope: Only touch files the task names; everything else read-only.
disambiguator: Interviewing to sharpen a plan before building -> this. Doing the visual design itself -> frontend-design.
